title: Touhou Koumakyou ~ the Embodiment of the Scarlet Devil - Danza de la Mente 📕 ~ Locked Girl ~ The Girl's Secret Room (Remix)
description:
❝ 𝐋𝐞𝐭'𝐬 𝐬𝐞𝐞... 𝐇𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐚𝐤𝐞 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐥𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧 𝐟𝐫𝐨𝐧𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐦𝐞
𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐝𝐨 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠... ❞
ㅤ- Patchouli Knowledge, 東方紅魔郷 〜 the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil (2002)

ㅤㅤ


Did an arrangement of Patchouli Knowledge's theme song, Locked Girl ~ The Girl's Secret Room, from Touhou 6 Kōmakyō ~ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil in celebration for the Touhou 6 Remake announcement!! Realized I only have (technically) two more songs to do (one more boss theme in particular), and I thought to start on that!! Only thing was I had a hard time deciding what to do for Patchouli's theme given I find it kinda repetitious (it's easily my least favorite of the boss themes in Touhou 6), but then I remembered that the 7/4 time signature exists, and that's how this came to be.

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. Original Volume, but sacrifices SMW-Compatibility (OG Volume)ㅤ[Listening-Only]
ㅤ2. Decreased Volume (LOWER Volume)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤㅤ ♠ What's disabled:
ㅤㅤㅤ - "Bonus End" (@7)
ㅤㅤㅤ - "P-Switch" (@12) ← ("CRONO Bongo.brr" is in its place in case you really need it)
ㅤㅤㅤ - Thunder SFX

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
ㅤ1. G Minor w/ Major Detune (Original Pitch)ㅤ[turned on by default]
ㅤ2. G# Minor (Custom Pitch)
ㅤ3. G Minor (Scarlet Weather Rhapsody Pitch)
ㅤ4. A Minor (Koumakyou Pitch)
ㅤ5. A# Minor (Azure Reflections Pitch)
